name: Core Rules
description: Basic races, classes, and backgrounds for character creation
author: Character Wizard

races.name: Human
races.description: Versatile and ambitious, humans are the most adaptable of all races.

races.name: Elf
races.description: Graceful and long-lived, elves are known for their magical affinity.

races.name: Dwarf
races.description: Stout and hardy, dwarves are master craftsmen and fierce warriors.

races.name: Halfling
races.description: Small but brave, halflings are known for their luck and stealth.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: Masters of martial combat, skilled with weapons and armor.
startingEquipment: Martial weapon and shield or two martial weapons
Light crossbow and 20 bolts or two handaxes

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: Regain hit points equal to 1d10 + fighter level as a bonus action.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: Take one additional action on your turn.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: Scholarly magic-users who wield arcane power through study.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Cast wizard spells using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Recover spell slots during a short rest.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: Skilled in stealth and deception, striking from the shadows.
startingEquipment: Shortbow and quiver of 20 arrows or shortsword
Burglar's pack, dungeoneer's pack, or explorer's pack
Leather armor, two daggers, thieves' tools

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Double proficiency bonus for two skills.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Deal extra damage when you have advantage or an ally nearby.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: Secret language known only to rogues.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: Divine spellcasters who serve the gods and heal the wounded.
startingEquipment: Scale mail, leather armor, or chain mail
Light crossbow and 20 bolts or any simple weapon

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Cast cleric spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Divine Domain
features.description: Choose a divine domain that grants special features.

backgrounds.name: Soldier
backgrounds.description: You served in an army and know military discipline.

feature.name: Military Rank
feature.description: Soldiers loyal to your former organization recognize your authority.

backgrounds.name: Sage
backgrounds.description: You spent years learning the lore of the multiverse.

feature.name: Researcher
feature.description: You know where to find information you don't know.

backgrounds.name: Criminal
backgrounds.description: You have a history of breaking the law.

feature.name: Criminal Contact
feature.description: You have a reliable contact in the criminal underworld.

backgrounds.name: Acolyte
backgrounds.description: You have spent your life in service to a temple.

feature.name: Shelter of the Faithful
feature.description: You can receive free healing and care at temples of your faith.
